text:
zoe_peopleops: Quick sync — I'm planning to lock the review timeline tomorrow. Two asks: 1) confirm calibration window availability next week, 2) confirm final deadline for self-assessments (is Fri 2026-04-10 still the cutoff?). Please reply with availability or propose alternatives by EOD today. :calendar:

ajohnson: For managers — if someone is OOO during the calibration slot, can we do an async read + vote? Also, how strict is the self-assessment deadline for ICs? A few people asked for a small extension if they have big launches this week.

linda_hr: Yes — we support async calibration votes. Process: add your comment + vote in the "Calibration Vote" column on the sheet and ping the calibration lead. Self-assessment deadline is Fri 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT. We can accept late submissions until Mon 2026-04-13 12:00 with a short note in the form explaining the delay. Links: https://redwoodcompany.share/pm/review-forms and https://redwoodcompany.share/pm/calibration-sheet

manager-mark: Thanks — where's the latest rubric? Also can you drop a 1-paragraph blurb I can forward to my team about what to include in self-assessments? Want to keep things consistent across eng.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Managers who opted into early reviews — draft manager comments due in 72 hours. Check the calendar invite or /reminders for details.

linda_hr: Rubric (v3) here: https://redwoodcompany.share/pm/rubric-v3.pdf. Copy/paste blurb for managers to forward: "Self-assessments guidance: 1) list your top 3 accomplishments with concrete outcomes; 2) note 1–2 growth areas with specific examples; 3) include links to 2–3 representative PRs or dashboards; 4) if you have a calibration preference (e.g., strong contributor/needs context), add a short note. Keep it <= 300 words."

linda_hr: Also dropping a tiny manager checklist snippet for uploads:
```
- Collect IC self-assessments by 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT
- Add manager comments by 2026-04-12 17:00 PDT
- Upload final forms to /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2 by 2026-04-13 12:00
- Submit calibration votes (sheet) by 2026-04-14 10:00
- If OOO, add async vote and mark yourself in the sheet
```

zoe_peopleops: Perfect — thanks Linda. One more ask: can calibration leads confirm their 90-min slots (Mon/Tue/Wed next week)? I'll send final invites after confirmations. :white_check_mark:

ajohnson: Confirmed for Tue 10:30-12:00. I'll block the room and add a hangouts link.

manager-mark: I'm good for Mon 14:00-15:30, but can swap if needed.

linda_hr: Calibration leads confirmed: Zoe, Jamal, and Priya. I've penciled in Mon 14:00-15:30, Tue 10:30-12:00, Wed 09:00-10:30. If anyone needs changes, reply here within 6 hours.

zoe_peopleops: Great — final timeline will go out in the morning. Managers, please ensure your teams get the blurb and the uplink to the forms. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
